titles.title: Don’t Stand for Taking Employed Americans’ Livings Act
Don’t STEAL Act
Don’t STEAL Act
A bill to amend the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to provide for increased criminal and civil penalties for wage theft, and for other purposes.
